method: Per-zone effective_rainfall warning thresholds (RESEARCH:22). FROZEN_BANDS keep scoring; thresholds overlay warning_state only. Initial values from per-zone historical effective rain median + 20mm (calibrated post-event, Taiwan-style). Update after each slide: threshold = 0.9*old + 0.1*event_effective_rain.
effective_rain_formula: effective = rainfall_7d + 0.3*rainfall_30d (simple proxy for antecedent, Monga 390 separator)
provenance: Initial thresholds from training matrix median effective rain per corridor + zone elevation offset (higher elevation lower threshold). Scores unchanged.
